changeSet.author: lifefit-architecture
changeSet.comment: Ticket: LF-0070. Store a private coach profile picture on the trainer profile. Index review: no new index; the picture is loaded with the trainer row by PK_TrainerProfiles. Performance note: the columns ride the existing trainer lookup used by the coaches page.

rollback.sql: IF COL_LENGTH(N'app.TrainerProfiles', N'PhotoContentType') IS NOT NULL ALTER TABLE app.TrainerProfiles DROP COLUMN PhotoContentType;
IF COL_LENGTH(N'app.TrainerProfiles', N'PhotoStorageKey') IS NOT NULL ALTER TABLE app.TrainerProfiles DROP COLUMN PhotoStorageKey;
